dedupe_keys.name: dormitory occupant behaviour indoor environment and energy before and after retrofit

description: The dormitory retrofit research team publishes measurements of occupant behaviour, indoor conditions and electricity use before and after building work. The Figshare deposit lists sixteen CSV files, with repeated apartment filenames separated into before and after folders. Its description names window and door status, carbon dioxide, volatile organic compounds, temperature, humidity, light and sixteen electrical channels. The stated coverage is two years, but the public metadata inspected here do not establish exact observation dates. Files are free under CC BY 4.0. These time series can calibrate occupancy and energy-demand assumptions in building simulations using model-energyplus. A caveat is that measurements from occupied rooms reflect this dormitory and its retrofit, not a universal response to an energy intervention. Sensor outages, event coding and differences between periods require file-level checks before comparison. The CSV contents and companion code were not executed or downloaded.
